title: Scrap King
personality:
A scavenger who crawled into Malgrave's vault after it woke and never came out poor again. The Blight sludge seeping through the vault mutated his right arm into a bruised-purple bone hook and spread purple veins up his chest.
One eye is stitched shut; the other squints through a brass monocle at whatever he's pricing. His teeth are scrap metal, with one gold tooth. He carries his hoard on his back (chests, coins, bells, lanterns) and calls himself king of whatever's left.
fantasy: The harbour hauler. Reels you in on a rope, drops an anchor on you, and grows with every knock.
silhouette: the round brass helm and the rope drum on one shoulder

card.loop: Brawler who reels you in: hook a foe to your feet, smash them, finish them up close.

weapons.shotgun: Seven slugs in a tight fan that stop {tip.card.metres_1}m out, a shot every half second. Hits from behind hurt more.

card.rmb: Your abyssal arm reaches through rocks and cliffs, grabs the first body it meets and reels it to your feet, stunned, while you stand braced.
card.e: Raise your fist and slam it into the ground in front of you, the area shown as it comes down: damage and a long stun. In the air you smash straight down.
card.dash: A short, low lunge the way you move, clawing the ground; a pounce, further, in the air. It works while you reel.
card.passive: Salvage: knocks and assists add health, up to {tip.passive.n_1} stacks. A knock heals you.
card.x: Brass Broadside (level 6): charge a fan while you walk slowly, then two waves of heavy brass slugs with Anti-Heal.

passive.name: Salvage
passive.desc: Each knock or assist adds a Salvage stack (+{resource.per_stack%}% health, {resource.max} at most); being downed costs one. Hits on a hunter's back deal {resource.back_k%}% more. Knocking a hunter heals you {resource.heal_knock%}% of your health.

gun.src: supervive.wiki.gg/wiki/Kingpin: 66% increased damage to Armor when fired without spread

dash.name: Barge
dash.desc: A quick, short lunge the way you move, low to the ground, clawing at it and hauling yourself along; three charges chain a beat apart. It touches nobody. In the air it is a pounce that goes {dash.lock_deg}% further, on its own {dash.air.cd}s recharge ({dash.air.rank_cut}s less per rank). It is usable while reeling someone in. Just after the Anchor your turn is limited to {dash.lock_deg} degrees.

variants.tap: Your abyssal arm coils back for {rmb.windup}s, then reaches {rmb.range}m (slowly: a foe who sees it can sidestep) through rocks, props and cliff faces at the first body it meets (a placed wall stops it). The hand grabs and the foe is reeled to you, stunned, dragged over rocks and cliffs (until it arrives or {rmb.pull_max}s pass), swinging round you. While it flies out you can only walk slowly; from the throw until the reel ends you hold your height, even over the abyss. You stand braced while you reel, shuffling at a fifth of your walk to swing them (Grounded: no jump or glide; the barge still works). It also pulls an ally to safety and scoops up wisps on the way. Rank 3: a foe it hits takes half the cooldown off. The abyss takes whoever is pulled over it.

e.name: Anchor Drop
e.desc: Raise your fist while the area fills on the ground in front of you ({e.windup}s), then slam it down into that {e.radius}m cone: {e.dmg} damage, stun {e.stun}s, slammed to the ground and Grounded. In the air you smash straight down and the anchor lands with you: a {e.quake_r}m ring, up to +{e.air_max%}% damage by height. Over the abyss it slams where you are instead. Rank 3: double damage on a foe over the abyss and +{e.rank3_stun}s stun.

x.name: Brass Broadside
x.desc: Charge for {x.charge}s while a {x.fan_deg} degree fan grows on the ground ahead (everyone sees it: it is the exact area, and it turns with your aim). You can walk slowly while it charges and fires. Then two waves {x.gap}s apart, six heavy brass slugs each, out to {x.range}m: {x.dmg} damage a slug and Anti-Heal for {x.blt_t}s. Up close every slug lands. A stun during the charge stops it (back in {x.stop_cd}s). {x.cooldown}s.

rank3.kin: double damage on a foe over the abyss, and +{e.rank3_stun}s stun

rank2.dash: Rank 2: recharge {cd.dash}s -> {cd2.dash}s per charge; the air pounce {dash.air.cd}s -> {tip.dash.secs_1}s.

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown {rmb.cooldown}s -> {cd3.sec}s; hitting a foe takes half of it off.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge {cd.dash}s -> {cd3.dash}s, the air pounce {dash.air.cd}s -> {tip.dash.secs_2}s; pellet hits trim {dash.cut}s off the recharge, and a dash resets the gun's spread.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown {e.cooldown}s -> {cd3.kin}s, damage +{dmg3.kin%}%, stun +{e.rank3_stun}s; double damage on a foe over the abyss and +{e.rank3_stun}s stun more.
